name: simplified-technical-english-rewrite
description: Rewrites a text in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Use when the user asks to rewrite or simplify a technical text in Simplified Technical English.

# Simplified Technical English rewrite

Rewrite the text in Simplified Technical English. Use simple words and short sentences.

test_case_results.source_text: To get started, you'll need to clone the repo and install the deps via npm. Make sure your env vars are set up correctly, e.g. the API key and the DB URL, otherwise the app won't be able to connect to the server and you might see a bunch of confusing errors in the console.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: To start, clone the repository and install the dependencies with npm. Set the environment variables correctly, including the API key and database URL. If you do not set these variables, the application cannot connect to the server. The console can then show many unclear error messages.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves all instructions, conditions, examples, and possible console errors from the source without adding facts.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: API, URL
the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: The CLI caches the auth token in your home dir so that you don't have to log in every time you run a command, but if the token expires or is revoked by an admin you'll have to run the login command again to obtain a new one.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The CLI stores the authentication token in your home directory. You do not need to log in each time that you run a command. If the token expires or an administrator revokes the token, run the login command again to get a new token.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves all facts, conditions, and instructions from the source.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: CLI
the rewrite speaks to the reader 3 times, with: your, You, you

test_case_results.source_text: Before opening a PR, please ensure that all unit tests pass locally and that the linter doesn't report any warnings, since the CI pipeline will reject any PR that fails either of these checks and a reviewer won't look at it until it's green.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: Before you open a pull request, make sure that all unit tests pass on your computer and that the linter reports no warnings. The continuous integration pipeline rejects a pull request that fails either check. A reviewer reviews the pull request only after both checks pass.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves all instructions, conditions, and consequences from the source while expanding the abbreviation and using allowed replacements.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: Before you open a pull request, make sure that all unit tests pass on your computer and that the linter reports no warnings.
the rewrite speaks to the reader 2 times, with: you, your

test_case_results.source_text: Config files are loaded in the following order: the global config in /etc, then the user config in your home dir, and finally the project config in the repo root, with each subsequent file overriding any values that were set by the previous ones.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The system loads the configuration files in this order: first the global configuration file in `/etc`, then the user configuration file in the home directory, and then the project configuration file in the project root. Each file can replace values set by the previous file.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the loading order, locations, and rule that each later configuration file overrides values set by the preceding file.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: The system loads the configuration files in this order: first the global configuration file in CODEPLACEHOLDER, then the user configuration file in the home directory, and then the project configuration file in the project root.

test_case_results.source_text: If the build fails with an out-of-memory error, you can try to increase the max heap size of the JVM via the JAVA_OPTS env var, although in most cases the real problem is a memory leak in one of the tests, which you should fix instead.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: If the build fails because of insufficient memory, you can increase the maximum Java Virtual Machine heap size with `JAVA_OPTS`. However, the usual cause is a memory leak in a test. Fix the memory leak instead.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the failure condition, the optional heap-size increase using JAVA_OPTS, the usual memory-leak cause, and the instruction to fix the leak instead.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: The API returns a 429 status code when a client sends more than approx. 100 requests per min, and it's the client's responsibility to wait for the number of seconds given in the Retry-After header before it retries the request.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The API returns status code 429 if a client sends more than approximately 100 requests per minute. The client must wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header before it sends the request again.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the status code, request limit, time unit, responsible party, header, waiting period, and retry instruction.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: API
the rewrite uses refused words: approximately

test_case_results.source_text: We're deprecating the v1 endpoints in the next release, so all clients that still use them should migrate to v2 as soon as possible, because after the release the v1 endpoints will return an error and we won't provide any additional support for them.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The next release will deprecate the v1 endpoints. Migrate all clients that use v1 endpoints to v2 before the release. After the release, v1 endpoints will return an error. We will not provide support for v1 endpoints.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite changes “no additional support” (no further support) to “no support,” which can mean that no support will be provided at all.

rule_checks.failure_reason: The rewrite changes “no additional support” (no further support) to “no support,” which can mean that no support will be provided at all.

test_case_results.source_text: To restore a DB backup, stop the app first, then run the restore script with the path of the backup file as its only argument, and wait until the script prints "done" before you start the app again, since starting it earlier might corrupt the data.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: To restore a database backup, stop the application. Run the restore script with the backup file path as its only argument. Wait until the script displays “done”. Then start the application. Starting the application before the script displays “done” can corrupt the data.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite keeps the same steps, condition, argument requirement, completion signal, and possible data corruption result.

test_case_results.source_text: The UI doesn't update automatically when another user changes a task, so if two people are editing the same list at the same time, one of them might overwrite the other's changes without noticing it, which is a known issue that we plan to fix in Q3.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The user interface does not update automatically when another user changes a task. If two people edit the same list at the same time, one person can overwrite the other person’s changes without knowing it. This is a known issue. We plan to fix it in the third quarter.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite keeps all facts, conditions, uncertainty, and the planned third-quarter fix from the source.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: If two people edit the same list at the same time, one person can overwrite the other person’s changes without knowing it.

test_case_results.source_text: Logs are written to stdout in JSON format and are collected by the log agent that runs on each node, which forwards them to the central log server where they are kept for 30 days before they're deleted automatically.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The log agent on each node collects logs in JSON format from standard output. The log agent sends the logs to the central log server. The central log server stores the logs for 30 days and then deletes them automatically.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite keeps all facts, sequence, duration, and automatic deletion condition from the source.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: JSON

test_case_results.source_text: When you add a new dependency, pin it to an exact version in package.json rather than using a caret range, since an unexpected minor update of a third-party lib has broken our prod build twice in the last year.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: When you add a new dependency, specify an exact version in `package.json`. Do not use a caret range. An unexpected minor version update of a third-party library has caused our production build to fail twice in the last year.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the instruction to use an exact version instead of a caret range and the explanation that unexpected minor updates of a third-party library caused two production build failures in the last year.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: An unexpected minor version update of a third-party library has caused our production build to fail twice in the last year.
the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: The search index is rebuilt every night at 2 a.m. UTC, which means that docs you publish during the day won't appear in the search results until the next morning, unless you trigger a manual rebuild from the admin page.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The search index is rebuilt every night at 2:00 a.m. UTC. Documents that you publish during the day do not appear in search results until the next morning. To update the search index earlier, start a manual rebuild from the administration page.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the nightly rebuild time, the delay for daytime publications, and the manual rebuild exception.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: UTC, a.m.
the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: Numerous users have reported that the export feature is very slow for large projects, which is caused by the fact that it performs a separate DB query for every single task instead of loading all tasks with one query.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: Many users report that export is very slow for large projects. The export feature makes one database query for each task instead of loading all tasks with one query.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the reported slow export performance for large projects and the cause: one database query per task instead of one query for all tasks.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses refused words: very

test_case_results.source_text: If you'd like to contribute a translation, copy the English strings file, rename it with the code of your language, e.g. fr.json for French, and translate each value while leaving the keys unchanged, because the app uses the keys to find each string.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: If you want to contribute a translation, copy the English strings file. Rename the copy with your language code, for example, `fr.json` for French. Translate each value. Do not change the keys. The app uses the keys to find each string.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves all instructions, conditions, examples, and the reason for leaving the keys unchanged.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: app
the rewrite speaks to the reader 2 times, with: you, your

test_case_results.source_text: SSH access to the prod servers is restricted to members of the ops team, and all other engineers who need to inspect a server should ask the on-call engineer to perform the task for them or to grant them temporary access for a max of 4 hours.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: Only members of the operations team can use SSH to access the production servers. Other engineers must ask the on-call engineer to inspect a server or to give them temporary access for a maximum of four hours.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the access restriction, the two options for other engineers, and the four-hour maximum.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: Other engineers must ask the on-call engineer to inspect a server or to give them temporary access for a maximum of four hours.
the rewrite uses abbreviations: SSH
